hooks.name: Medical safety review
hooks.description: After the agent edits a file, checks that safety framing, AHA targets and the drift-free estimator rules are intact.

action.prompt: If you just changed user-facing text in src/App.tsx, README.md or the coach in src/cpr.ts: the call-911/112 buttons and "Training aid, not a medical device" must stay on every screen, and nothing may claim Lazarus diagnoses, treats or is certified. If you changed RATE_MIN, RATE_MAX, DEPTH_MIN or DEPTH_MAX, cite the guideline that justifies it. If you changed estimate(), it must still avoid double integration, and every property in .kiro/specs/lazarus/design.md must still have a passing test with its original tolerance.
